cohort: The study included 108 patients diagnosed with Placenta Accreta Spectrum Disorder (PASD) who underwent surgery between January 2019 and December 2022, primarily women aged 20-35 years with parity of 4 or more, and a history of at least one Cesarean section.
finding: Internal iliac artery ligation was not found to significantly reduce bleeding or operative duration when performed alongside either resection or hysterectomy for Placenta Accreta Spectrum Disorder (PASD), although bleeding and operative duration differed significantly between resection and hysterectomy alone.
